title: antirrhinum coulterianum f. orcuttianum
intro: Antirrhinum coulterianum f. orcuttianum, commonly known as Coulter's snapdragon, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is a flowering plant known for its unique, tubular flowers. Coulter's snapdragon has been found to have several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
